summary: NewcelX Ltd. (formerly NLS Pharmaceutics) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement with accredited investors. The company agreed to sell 347,134 common shares or pre-funded warrants at $4.033 per share, plus warrants to buy 347,134 shares at $4.437 for five years, raising $1.4 million gross. Proceeds will fund NCEL-101 development and working capital. The offering includes a 60-day standstill and a registration rights obligation. Expected close is August 14, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: timely closing and registration filing.
